messages:
Priya: Quick pulse — SDK v1.6 release: we need a final dep scrub + sample app fixes before the changelog freeze tomorrow 11:00 PST. Who's locking down deps?
Marco: I can take dependency diffs for the JS SDK. Will scan package-lock and flag semver bumps.
Sasha: I'm on sample apps. One failing test in electron-sample that blocks the smoke. Investigating.
QA Ana: I'll run the final smoke suite tonight after Marco's PRs land. ETA ~22:00 PST.
Marco: Found two transitive bumps: jquery-ish -> 3.6.0 and grpc-web patch. Opened PR #4123 for the grpc pin.
Priya: Thanks. Marco, can you include the lockfile update + changelog entry in the same PR? Makes cut easier.
Marco: Yep — updating. Also adding a short note for the changelog: "Pin grpc-web to avoid intermittent build failures on node 18".
Sasha: electron-sample failing was due to an env path in test harness. Pushed fix in my branch, but it's blocked by the CI matrix flake. Recording logs: ```npm test --silent
> electron-sample test
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/tmp/sandbox/key.pem'```
QA Ana: Repro locally, adding a fixture for key.pem in test harness. Will push a tiny PR to your branch if that's ok @Sasha.
Sasha: Please do. If QA can push the fixture, I can re-run tests and merge. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: Reminder — changelog freeze scheduled in 13 hours (3712399600). Please ensure PRs target release/v1.6 and include changelog snippets.
Priya: Ownership check: Marco for JS deps (PR #4123), Sasha for sample apps (branch sasha/sample-fix), QA Ana for smoke validation, Doc Steve for changelog + quickstarts update.
Doc Steve: I'll draft the changelog bullet points and a short migration note for the quickstart that mentions pinning grpc-web. Expect a draft by 09:30 PST.
Marco: FYI, cherry-pick command for the lockfile change if needed: ```git fetch origin && git checkout -b rel/lockfix && git cherry-pick abc1234 && git push origin rel/lockfix```
Priya: If any PR misses the freeze, we do a post-freeze tiny cherrypick window but it'll require explicit signoff from Eng Leads. Try to avoid.
QA Ana: Smoke run schedule: 22:00 local -> run samples + CI matrix. I will tag @Priya and @Marco on results.
Sasha: Merging my fixed sample once QA patch is in. Will ping in thread.
Doc Steve: Added changelog draft in docs PR #887. Short bullets, two lines each.
Marco: PR #4123 merged. Lockfile updated. :tada:
QA Ana: Ran smoke — all samples pass except mobile-demo on iOS simulator (flaky). Filing follow-up ticket M-78. Passing for cutoff.
Priya: Great work team. Final ask: everyone confirm that changelog entries are in their PRs and target branch is release/v1.6. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.
Marco: :white_check_mark:
Sasha: :white_check_mark:
QA Ana: :white_check_mark:
Doc Steve: :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'll do the final rollup and file the consolidated changelog before freeze. Thanks!
